AST SpaceMobile & IRIS² – Public PDF Specification & Technical Document Links

Compiled: October 28, 2026. Scope: (A) AST SpaceMobile: BlueWalker 3, BlueBird Block 1 and Block 2 (array size, beams, throughput, bands), the direct-to-cell/SCS architecture, 3GPP/NTN aspects, FCC and experimental filings, SEC/investor documents, partner filings, foreign regulators and independent analyses. (B) IRIS² (Infrastructure for Resilience, Interconnectivity and Security by Satellite): Regulation (EU) 2023/588, Commission/DG DEFIS, EUSPA, ESA, SpaceRISE (Eutelsat, SES, Hispasat), GOVSATCOM requirements, EPRS, the European Court of Auditors, ITU filing context and academic work. Covers constellation figures (original 290 = 264 high-LEO + 18 MEO + 10 low-LEO; Aug 2026 update to 348 = 330 LEO + 18 MEO), latency, throughput and EuroQCI/QKD.

Verification: Links were checked on Oct 28, 2026. Direct PDFs were confirmed with curl (HTTP 200, real %PDF file, page count). FCC ELS, FCC ULS, FCC.report and Ofcom block scripted downloads, so those links were checked by fetching their content or document record. "Mirror" marks a copy hosted by a third party. "[HTML]" marks a direct page where no PDF exists. One exception is flagged in its row: EUR-Lex returns a bot challenge to every automated fetch, so a Council-hosted copy of the adopted text is listed next to it.

Gaps & notes

  • AST – no official datasheet: AST publishes no satellite or gateway datasheet PDF. Block 1 (~693–700 sq ft / 64 m²) and Block 2 (~2,400 sq ft / ~223 m²) array sizes, the 40 MHz-per-beam / 120 Mbps peak figures and the 10,000 MHz processing bandwidth come from investor decks, 10-K text and FCC exhibits. Per-satellite beam counts for Block 1/2 are not public; the only figure is "up to 2,800 user beams" in the 2020 technical statement.
  • AST FCC: the 2025–2026 SCS modification technical exhibits (e.g., SAT-MOD-20250612-00145 and its amendments) could not be pinned to stable FCC.report document links. ICFS/IBFS direct downloads block scripted access. The FCC orders (DA 24-756, DA 26-391) summarize the granted parameters. Verizon's Form 608 lease exhibit was found but not verified, so only AT&T's is listed.
  • AST ITU: BW3 and the BlueBirds operate under ITU filings made by Papua New Guinea (MICRONSAT) and later U.S. filings. No ITU filing PDFs (API/CR/C, Schedule) are publicly downloadable; ITU SNS/SNL entries are interactive. ITU-hosted AST presentations are listed instead.
  • AST partners: Verizon and Vodafone have no public technical PDFs on AST (only press releases and HTML). The Vodafone–AST European D2D joint venture is described only in press releases and news. No 3GPP Tdoc by AST was located; the AT&T lease exhibit states SCS is designed to meet 3GPP standards incl. Release 17.
  • AST astronomy and link budget: no peer-reviewed BlueBird radio-astronomy interference paper was found. AST's coordination agreement with NRAO/NSF is announced only in press releases. Public link-budget analyses are generic D2D studies, not AST-specific.
  • IRIS² legal texts: EUR-Lex (Regulation 2023/588, Implementing Decision 2023/1054 on the GOVSATCOM service portfolio) blocks all automated fetches. The OJ PDF link is listed with a flag and backed by the verified Council PE-CONS text.
  • IRIS² specs: no public document gives per-satellite throughput, total capacity (Gbps/Tbps), latency in ms, or detailed orbit tables for the 348-satellite configuration. The concession contract is not public; only press releases, the SES investor deck and Commission factsheets summarize it. No dedicated European Court of Auditors special report on IRIS² exists yet; ECA Opinion 01/2026 is the closest.
  • IRIS² ITU filings: the filings (France FMS-LEO, Germany DEUMULTIORBIT; SES O3bNext for commercial capacity) are documented only in news and ANFR posts. No ITU PDF is available.
  • IRIS² academic and QKD: peer-reviewed analyses are scarce. The UPC (Barcelona) thesis comparing LEO/MEO/hybrid IRIS² architectures sits behind a security check (HTTP 418), and the IAC-24 full paper needs an IAF login (only the brief is linked). EuroQCI/IRIS² QKD link-level specs (EAGLE-1 integration) have no public technical PDF; only ESA web pages and the 2021 arXiv review cover them.
